name: Urgot
title: the Dreadnought

Q.name: Corrosive Charge
Q.description: Urgot fires an explosive charge, dealing 25/70/115/160/205 + 0.7×AD physical damage and Slowing by 45/50/55.0/60/65% for 1.25 seconds.
Q.summary: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

W.name: Purge
W.description: Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds. Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them 3 times a second dealing 12 + 0.2/0.235/0.27/0.305/0.34×AD physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has 40% Slow resistance, but loses 125 Move Speed. At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off.
W.summary: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

E.name: Disdain
E.description: Urgot charges forward, gaining 55/75/95/115/135 + 1.35×bonus AD + 0.135×bonus max HP Shield for 4 seconds. The first champion hit is Stunned for 1.5 seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take 90/120/150/180/210 + 1×bonus AD physical damage.
E.summary: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

R.name: Fear Beyond Death
R.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing 100/225/350 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage and Slowing for 4 seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to 75%. If the impaled victim falls below 25% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for 1.5 seconds.
R.summary: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

Passive.name: Echoing Flames
Passive.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.
Passive.summary: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Juggernaut who fires shotgun blasts from his legs as he attacks or uses W. Wins lane by marking a target with Q or E and shredding it with W, and wins fights by executing a low target with R and fearing those nearby.
strengths: E charge shields him, stuns the first champion for 1.5 s and flips them behind him
W chain gun attacks 3 times a second at the marked target and gives 40% slow resistance
Passive leg shotguns deal % max health damage in the direction of his attack, each leg on its own cooldown
R drill slows by missing health; below 25% health he can drag them in, execute them and fear nearby enemies
Q slows 45–65%, setting up E and W
weaknesses: Low mobility: E is his only dash and it's slow and telegraphed
Kited by ranged champions when E misses
R execute only works below 25% health; before that it's just a slow
W cooldown is long early (12 s at rank 1, 0 at rank 5)
Weak to champions that dodge or block E
profile.curveNote: Wants Q to mark and slow, E to engage and W to shred; legs fire much more with W.

Passive.notes: Leg shotguns fire on attacks and W hits, each leg with its own cooldown.

Q.notes: Delayed explosive charge; slows; marks for W.

W.notes: Chain gun: 3 attacks/s at the closest (marked) enemy; slow resistance.

E.notes: Charge; shield; first champion stunned 1.5 s and flipped behind.

R.notes: Drill slows by missing health; below 25% recast suppresses, drags and executes, fearing nearby enemies.

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown (16–14 s) or missed: trade; he can't catch you. Early W ranks have long cooldowns.
